newsitem.title: USA: Woodroast Systems names Ralph Guarino COO.
newsitem.headline: Woodroast Systems names Ralph Guarino COO.

text.p: Woodroast Systems Inc said Thursday that Ralph Guarino has been named president and chief operating officer. Woodroast Systems founder Sheldon Jacobs will remain chief executive officer and chairman of the board of directors, the company said.
Guarino has held executive positions in a number of restaurant chains and is an original member of the management team for Boston Chicken restaurants, the company said.
Guarino will lead the expansion of Woodroast Systems' Shelly's Back Room "Civilized Cigar Parlor" and Shelly's Woodroast restaurant concepts, the company said.
